decisions.reason: 신경 쓰지 않았다 is failing to pay attention, not omitting a glance.
Unifies the monster with the chapter’s established it, matching the omitted Korean subject.
Keeps the reply aligned with the it-pronoun in the prior line.
Same pronoun continuity for the charging warrior.
탱커 is unmarked singular; 위치다 is a formation position, not a casual spot.
decisions.replacement: The team snapped into formation. I gripped my spear and moved as ordered. Between the tank and the ranged dealers. Dead center—that was my position.

decisions.reason: 중급 is mid-grade, and the proverb names a broken nose and cracked skull as the situation, not Taekyung’s injury.
그 자체만으로도 is the creature itself, not the sight of it.
바닥에 고정 is planting the shield in the ground, not bracing it against the ground.
직사로 쏘아졌다 is direct fire at the target, not arrows merely flying in a line.
투두둑 is a dull successive thunk, not a crack.
가볍게 휘두른 is a casual swing, and 두꺼운 가죽 is thick hide.
비할 바가 아니었다 is the English power-up idiom; ordinary level is not System Level.
도약했다 is a leap; 쩌렁쩌렁한 is a thunderous roar.
모두가 is everyone, not an unspecified they.
박살 냈다 is smash to pieces; 풍압 is a blast of air, not displaced air.
터져 나왔다 is erupted, not merely broke out.
물든 is a wash of haze; SOL adds lost and pales the image without gain.
Joins the two hands into one continuing motion instead of a chopped fragment.
닿았다 is touched; 축축하다 is damp, not wet.
꽤 멀리 떨어져 있는데 preserves pretty far.
더듬어 갔다 is feeling around; 물체 is an object, and probed is clinical.
사람인가 as A person? keeps the clipped thought.
정신을 잃고 is passing out, not being knocked unconscious.
바로 위에서 is the source of the reply, from directly above.
Needs both 때마침 and 어디선가.
decisions.replacement: Just then, a gust of wind swept through from somewhere and cleared the dust. I slowly looked up and saw a pair of gleaming red eyes.

decisions.reason: 움켜쥐고 is a clamped grip, not wrapped around.
Keep 그건 수컷의; disgust with myself is the idiomatic pairing.
decisions.replacement: That was a male’s instinct. Unbearable nausea. Disgust with myself. The next moment, my grip went slack on its own.

decisions.reason: 힘없이 내려가는 is falling limply, cleaner than dropped, limp.
난도질 is wild indiscriminate hacking, not merely hacking in every direction.
진짜 위험했다 is seriously close; 작살냈다 is demolished.
날렸다 of arrows and thrown weapons is pelting, not pouring on.
눈이 뒤집힌 is the berserk idiom, not literal rolled-back eyes.
한탄했다 is lamenting the choice, not cursing luck.
남자의 마음 is a man’s heart, not a man’s need.
아슬아슬하게 빗겨 나갔다 is a hair’s-breadth miss; 위기의 연속 is one close call after another.
험한 꼴을 보다 means going through hell, not only seeing it.
놈의 공격 keeps the possessor; 목숨을 살리고 있었다 is kept saving my life.
방향을 틀었다 is veered; 다시 수비 대형을 갖춘 is back in formation.
쫓아오는 is chasing; 하급 is low-grade; 파괴력 is destructive force.
decisions.replacement: Im Kkeokjeong charged the Great Warrior chasing me. Blue mana sheathed his tower shield, packed with enough destructive force to smash most low-grade monsters to pieces.

decisions.reason: 빠른 속도로 튕겨 나왔다 keeps the speed; hurtling drops it.
황당해하는 나와는 달리 is stunned contrast, not added staring.
또 다른 탱커 is another tank, not the other tank.
wiping is awkward, but 꿀밤 is a knuckle to the skull, not a generic bonk.
decisions.replacement: That was the sound of the team being wiped out. The last member had charged in with a dagger, taken a knuckle to the skull, and gone flying. He twitched, then passed out.

decisions.reason: 천만다행 is thank goodness, stronger than small mercies.
방금 했던 말 취소 is the idiom scratch that, not I took it back.
시선을 고정한 채 is eyes fixed, not merely kept on.
치열한 is fierce, not brutal; 계속되고 is going on, not raging.
decisions.replacement: A fierce fight was still going on at the altar in the distance.

decisions.reason: 지친 목소리 is tired; came through matches 들려왔다 without raising register.
넘은 것 같은데요 is it feels like, not a cooler I think.
벼락이 치고 is lightning struck, the standard collocation.
인 줄 알겠네 is would think; 추가 시간 선언 still lands as a referee’s call.
decisions.replacement: Anyone who didn’t know better would think he was a soccer referee. His bold call for extra time left me speechless.

decisions.reason: 다가온다 is came on, not advanced; 슬금슬금 물러났다 is edged backward.
decisions.replacement: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior came on slowly. A cruel smile hung on its wide-slit mouth. I edged backward in time with its steps.

decisions.reason: 어쩔 수 없다 stays clipped; stall already covers 시간을 끄는.
내 생각대로 움직이지 않았다 is not moving as expected, not refusing to play along.
the teammates is stiff; my teammates is the natural English for 팀원들.
그 설마가 맞았다 is the short punch; SOL over-explains.
철렁 내려앉는다 is sank; 뒷모습 must stay.
decisions.replacement: My heart sank as I watched its back heading for Im Kkeokjeong.

decisions.reason: 인마 is a rude hail, weaker than 개새끼 but stronger than you.
완전한 무시뿐 naturalizes to it ignored me completely without the gerund clunk.
the one panicking is cleaner spoken English than in a panic.
이대로 두면 is leaving the situation like this, not leaving the monster alone.
시선을 끌다 is draw attention, not pull its eyes; 널려 있는 돌 is rocks scattered around.
향해 뛰기 is running toward, not at.
임꺽정은 물론이고 다른 팀원들까지 is not only Kkeokjeong but the rest too.
일대일 승부 is a one-on-one fight.
절대 이길 수 없는 싸움이다 keeps fight as the subject of the maxim.
싸워야 할 때가 있다 is a present-tense maxim, not past narration.
야, 이 개새끼야 keeps the hail that pulls aggro.
돌아섰다 is turned, not spun; 옆구리 is the side, not the waist.
이걸 노렸구나 is addressed to the monster, not a third-person this was what it wanted.
하얗게 물든다 is mind going blank; 같잖은 죄책감과 영웅심 is cheap guilt and heroics.
decisions.replacement: My mind went blank. Could I even block that? Had I made the wrong call out of some cheap guilt and heroics?

decisions.reason: the die was already cast keeps the English idiom; had been cast is stiffer.
Present-tense 목숨을 걸고 싸워야 할 때가 있다 plus 지금이 바로 그랬다 already land.
No extra paragraph; Korean keeps both sentences together.
진로를 틀었다 is redirecting, not swinging; into its path is ambiguous.
decisions.replacement: I clenched my teeth and turned the iron spear into the greatsword’s path. At the same time, the greatsword smashed into it.

decisions.reason: 구그긍 is a grinding rumble, not a creaking rrrk.
갈라 버렸…… is a fake completed cut; was going to spoils the reversal.
Spear-and-waist check is already two short sentences; no extra break.
허리도 stays with 철창도 in one beat.
게 전부였다 is all that had happened, including the 아주 살짝 coda.
아주 살짝 is a comma intensification, not a new paragraph.
뭐야, 이거 is what was this, not what was going on.
철창 위를 후려친다 is against the spear, not smashed down; 정신이 없는 와중 is my confusion.
밀렸다 as slid back and slid backward are indistinguishable.
엥 is a dumber sound than the earlier 어, so Uhh not a second Huh.
공중에서 마주쳤다 is eyes meeting in the air between them.
이소군과의 비무 is the duel with Lee Seogeun, not my duel.
레벨만 보고 is after seeing his Level; 어떻게 잊을까 is how could I forget.
거긴 is there, the Murim duel, not then.
시스템이고 나발이고 아무것도 없는 is no System, no nothing, without added damn.
도대체 is how the hell, stronger than how is this even.
아무것도 보이지도 들리지도 is anything, not a thing.
이럴 리가 없는데 is this can’t be; 진짜 말도 안 되는 is seriously makes no sense, not insane or happening.
decisions.replacement: This can’t be. This seriously makes no sense.

decisions.reason: 전승됩니다 is present are inherited, not present perfect.
새어 나온다 is slipped out; 미친놈 is the crazy one, without added italics.
목을 is its throat; 뱉어 낼 is spit out; 맴도는 is hovering.
decisions.replacement: A wrinkled hand clutched at its throat. But the old goblin had neither the strength to stop the blood pouring out like a waterfall nor the time to spit out the spell still hovering on the tip of its tongue.

decisions.reason: 빛이 꺼졌다 is the light went out, not faded.
피곤하다 is tired, not exhausted.
얼마나 … 할지 is no telling how brutal; the Korean does not say the other.
decisions.replacement: But he turned around at once. He still had work to do. There was no telling how brutal the fight against a C-rank Rare Monster would be—

decisions.reason: 크와아악 matches this chapter’s Kuwaaaaargh rendering of the same roar family.
헛것을 봤다고 생각했다 is its own double-take before the restatement.
바로 그 is that same; 잘려 나간 is severed; 물러나고 있었다 stays progressive.
decisions.replacement: That same Hobgoblin Great Warrior was screaming. One arm severed, it was staggering back.

decisions.reason: 몸놀림 is movement, not footwork; 잊은 채 바라봤다 is watched while forgetting, not simply stared.
잠깐 is a full-stop beat before the spear realization.
창이라고? lands as its own question after Wait.
오늘 모인 이들 is everyone gathered here today.
바로 그였다 is it was him.
배낭을 메고 is carrying a backpack, not hauling.
지금 도대체 as what on earth and what in the world are equal; keep BASE.
